focuses.name: Irkutsk, Not Moscow
focuses.desc:
The war was lost, Moscow was lost, and the Emergency Government hunted him across the Urals. He is still the Vozhd.

Starting spirits (negative): The Vozhd's Paranoia, Food Shortages, An Army That Lost, Siberian White Army Remnant Resistance.

Effect: +5% stability.

focuses.name: The Whites in the Taiga
focuses.desc:
It happens anyway. Kolchak's men never all went to Harbin. Their sons kept the rifles, and with the Red Army broken they have come out of the forest.

Effect: Siberian White Army Remnant Resistance grows stronger.

focuses.name: Ambushes on the Amur Road
focuses.desc:
It happens anyway. Convoys vanish between Chita and Blagoveshchensk, and the villages say they saw nothing.

Effect: Siberian White Army Remnant Resistance at its worst; -supply in the eastern states.

focuses.name: The Ataman's Banner Raised Again
focuses.desc:
It happens anyway. Semyonov's old banner flies over a Transbaikal stanitsa, and Cossacks ride under it.

Effect: Siberian White Army Remnant Resistance grows; -5% stability.

focuses.name: The Vozhd Still Rules
focuses.desc:
Every order still goes out under his name, as it did from the Kremlin.

Effect: +50 political power.

focuses.name: Portraits in Every Office
focuses.desc:
His face on every wall from Chita to Magadan.

Effect: communist popularity +10%.

focuses.name: Pravda of the East
focuses.desc:
The Irkutsk Pravda tells the people that the war was not lost - it was betrayed.

Effect: +5% war support.

focuses.name: The Cult Reborn
focuses.desc:
Songs, statues, a new short course of party history.

Effect: +10% stability.

focuses.name: Moscow Was Lost by Traitors
focuses.desc:
Not by him. Never by him.

Effect: +10% war support, -5% stability.

focuses.name: The Marshals Who Came East
focuses.desc:
Every commander here was on the train east with him. They are all the high command he has left.

Effect: +army experience, new generals.

focuses.name: The Union Lives in Irkutsk
focuses.desc:
The lawful government of the USSR, in exile in its own country.

Effect: claims on Popov's republic.

focuses.name: The Few Who Came East
focuses.desc:
Every man around him chose the Vozhd over Moscow and followed him across Siberia. That ought to be enough. It is not.

Effect: The Vozhd's Paranoia grows; +50 political power.

focuses.name: The Vozhd Sleeps Badly
focuses.desc:
He does this himself. Someone warned him in Moscow, so someone could betray him here.

Effect: The Vozhd's Paranoia grows.

focuses.name: Tasters at Every Meal
focuses.desc:
Nothing reaches his table that someone else has not eaten first.

Effect: -5% stability.

focuses.name: Rule by Telephone
focuses.desc:
He stops leaving the house. Orders come down the line at three in the morning.

Effect: The Vozhd's Paranoia eases a little; -10% political power gain.

focuses.name: Show Himself to the Troops
focuses.desc:
A review on the parade ground, every rifle unloaded first.

Effect: +10% war support; The Vozhd's Paranoia grows.

focuses.name: Nobody Enters Without Papers
focuses.desc:
Passes, countersigned passes, and guards who check each other's.

Effect: -5% stability, +5% resistance to enemy spies.

focuses.name: Doctors Under Suspicion
focuses.desc:
He does this himself. Even the men who take his pulse might be poisoners.

Effect: The Vozhd's Paranoia grows; -5% research speed.

focuses.name: The Vozhd Alone
focuses.desc:
Loyal men all around him, and he trusts none of them - but there is nobody to shoot, so the fear simply stays.

Effect: The Vozhd's Paranoia becomes permanent at its height; +0.1 daily political power.

focuses.name: Shadows in the Corridor
focuses.desc:
He does this himself. He hears footsteps where there are none.

Effect: The Vozhd's Paranoia grows.

focuses.name: The Hungry Winter
focuses.desc:
He does this himself. The far east never fed itself; the grain came from the west, and the west is gone.

Effect: Food Shortages worsen.

focuses.name: Kolkhoz Quotas
focuses.desc:
Every collective farm east of Baikal gets a number it has to meet.

Effect: Food Shortages weakened.

focuses.name: Raise the Quotas
focuses.desc:
If the farms cannot meet the quota, the quota is not high enough.

Effect: Food Shortages weakened; -5% stability.

focuses.name: Allow Private Plots
focuses.desc:
A heresy, but it feeds people.

Effect: Food Shortages weakened; communist popularity -5%.

focuses.name: Fish from the Sea of Okhotsk
focuses.desc:
The fishing fleet at Magadan and Nikolayevsk feeds the cities.

Effect: Food Shortages weakened.

focuses.name: Grain from Buryatia
focuses.desc:
The steppe south of Baikal is the only farmland worth the name.

Effect: removes Food Shortages.

focuses.name: Rice Through Manchuria
focuses.desc:
Bought from the Japanese, quietly.

Effect: +opinion with Japan; +consumer goods relief.

focuses.name: Forty Percent of the Red Army
focuses.desc:
The divisions that followed him east are the largest army in Asia that is not Japanese.

Effect: +army experience.

focuses.name: Re-form the Fronts
focuses.desc:
Transbaikal Front, Far Eastern Front - the old names, the old staffs.

Effect: +5% division organisation.

focuses.name: Guard the Trans-Siberian
focuses.desc:
One railway holds the whole country together.

Effect: +infrastructure along the line.

focuses.name: The Amur Works
focuses.desc:
Komsomolsk and Khabarovsk build what Moscow used to send.

Effect: +1 military factory.

focuses.name: Guns from Ulan-Ude
focuses.desc:
The locomotive works can build artillery too.

Effect: artillery added to the stockpile.

focuses.name: Plan West
focuses.desc:
The staff draws the arrows towards Tomsk.

Effect: +5% attack against the CSR.

focuses.name: Hang the Traitor Popov
focuses.desc:
Popov took the army he was given to hunt the Vozhd and made himself a president with it. He will answer for it.

Effect: declares war on the Central Siberian Republic. About half a year in, the collapse mechanic (to be added) decides it.
